summary.text: Terri Yarbrough Green is the Democratic nominee for Arkansas's 1st Congressional District. A medical pathologist who moved to Northeast Arkansas in 1988 and recently retired, she has not held elected office before and says she decided to run because no other Democrat had filed. She is running on campaign finance reform and universal healthcare, and has also emphasized farm and fuel costs.

paragraphs.text: Adopted at birth, according to Talk Business & Politics; describes herself as the daughter of a high school football coach and athletic director.
Graduated from Burges High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Baylor University in 1977; also attended the University of Texas at Arlington.
Received a medical degree from the University of Texas Health Science Center in San Antonio.
Worked as a medical pathologist and moved to Northeast Arkansas in 1988; her Ballotpedia profile calls her semi-retired, and Talk Business & Politics reported in 2026 that she had recently retired.
Has been active with the Greene County Democratic Party and has worked on voter registration, according to Talk Business & Politics; Talk Business lists her as a Democrat from Paragould.
Is running for office for the first time; the Democratic primary was canceled and she advanced to the general election without appearing on the ballot.
